preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**6 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes N is between 1 and 1000000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N-1 for N, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N-1)] for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges) for N, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N-1)] for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]]))
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) in each test case connects nodes between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(values) == N for N, values in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N node values.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= A_i <= 10**9 for A_i in values) for values in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each node value A_i in each test case is between 0 and 1000000000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(u != v for u, v in edges) for edges in [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N-1)] for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]])
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) in each test case connects two distinct nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(u for u, _ in edges).union(set(v for _, v in edges))) == N for N, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N-1)] for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case's edges form a connected graph with N nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(0 < L_u for L_u in leaf_securities)
postconditions.description: The security of each leaf node L_u is greater than 0.
The minimum security of the tree is the sum of the securities of all leaf nodes.
